# Check stashedHTML2text behavior
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', r'''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import stashedHTML2text

md_text = """[TOC]

# `<test>`
"""
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc"])

# Patch TocTreeprocessor.run to add debug output
original_run = md.treeprocessors['toc'].run

def debug_run(doc):
    for el in doc.iter():
        if isinstance(el.tag, str) and el.tag.startswith('h'):
            from markdown.extensions.toc import get_name
            name = get_name(el)
            print(f"get_name: {repr(name)}")
            
            sht = stashedHTML2text(name, md)
            print(f"stashedHTML2text: {repr(sht)}")
    
    return original_run(doc)

md.treeprocessors['toc'].run = debug_run

html = md.convert(md_text)
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-500:])
